inputs.headline:
離れていても、
家族のそばに。
inputs.subline: 一日ひとつの質問で、毎日を分かち合う。
inputs.prompt:
Use case: compositing. Asset type: final Japanese App Store portrait promotional screenshot, not a mockup. Edit the supplied real app screenshot by laying it onto a designed poster. Output exactly 1320 pixels wide by 2868 pixels tall, opaque PNG, same portrait aspect ratio as input. Keep the complete supplied app screenshot intact and legible as an inset: scale it uniformly to width 948 px and height 2060 px at x186,y748. Do not redraw or invent anything in the UI, do not change a single word, icon, status bar or layout in the supplied screenshot. Preserve original screenshot content. The inset has square corners and a crisp 12px cyan/pale-blue beveled border, matching the app's squared paper-panel/buttons, with no phone device casing. Overall backdrop: completely flat charcoal #2B2B2B, subtle regular grid of tiny square dots #414141 about 7px squares with 58px spacing. At top, x94,y115: a small cyan wordmark reading exactly "つつうら". At x94,y242: two-line, left-aligned large white Japanese headline around 92px; its striking angular constructed Japanese typography should match the app source's Kaisotai-Next-UP-B font, as visible in its button/heading lettering. Use square corners, triangular cutouts, straight geometric strokes in the heading. Below at x94,y535 a clean easy-to-read white Japanese sans-serif subline about 37px. Header text must be exact, with balanced breathing room. Keep overall typography and style identical across the series. No gradients, no rounded cards or corners, no curved phone frame, no new illustrations, no ornaments, no 3D, no drop shadow blur, no notch, no watermark. All marketing text is outside the intact inset app screenshot. Main headline (verbatim, preserve line break): "離れていても、
家族のそばに。". Subline (verbatim): "一日ひとつの質問で、毎日を分かち合う。".
